item.title: Honoring a Legacy, Advancing a Mission: Wolf Ridge Begins Search for Next Executive Director
item.description: Next year will be 40 years of service in environmental education for me, 39 with Wolf Ridge. Now on solid ground following the pandemic, and with a simply outstanding leadership team in place, it feels to be the right time to retire from Wolf Ridge, to another role or phase of life. I will be retiring by May of 2026.
